title: 第5章 打服为止第6章 十年灵草
content_zh:
“秦仲，秦华？”
秦浩眉头一皱，“你们找我有什么事？”
这两人，是秦家嫡系子弟。
没有检测武魂之前，这两人是秦浩的跟班，经常跟在秦浩的屁股后面，对他十分尊敬。
可如今哪里还有尊敬，脸上满是鄙夷、不屑。
秦仲语气酸溜溜的，嫉妒道：“当然是找你要淬体丹，别以为我们不知道，家主给你送了二十枚淬体丹，秦浩，你一个废物，拿着这么多淬体丹也是浪费，不如给我们！”
秦华恨道：“不错，秦浩，你不要不识抬举，我们两人虽然修炼一般，但已经是淬体境二重，对付你一个废物绰绰有余！
不想挨打，那就老老实实交出淬体丹！”
秦浩一怔，他才拿到淬体丹不久，这两人就找上门来了，看来这件事在家族内闹出了不小动静。
秦浩冷冷看了两人一眼，道：“淬体丹我已经服下了，你们滚吧！”
秦华脸色一下子冷了下来，冷笑一声，“秦浩，找理由也找个正当的，就算是秦方少爷，也做不到半日炼化二十枚淬体丹，更何况你这个废物，看样子你是不见棺材不掉泪，既然你找打，我就成全你！”
“霹雳拳！”
话音刚落，秦华狞笑一声，挥舞着右拳紧猛地往秦浩轰出。
“找死！”
秦浩大怒，他不找两人麻烦也就算了，两人竟然还敢对他动手，心中怒火爆开，暴喝一声，同样一拳打去。
黄级初阶武技，虎啸拳！
如猛虎低吼，撕咬而下，气势汹汹。
“不好，是大成的虎啸拳，秦华，我来帮你！”
站在旁边的秦仲大惊，往前跳出一步，同样一拳打向秦浩。
“哼！”

秦浩浑然不惧，一拳掠向秦华的同时，右脚往秦仲扫了过去，顿时疾风如影，秦仲只感到风声呼啸。
砰砰！
一拳！
一脚！
几乎同时打在秦华和秦仲身上。
“啊！
我的手！
秦浩，你敢废掉我的手臂！”
拳拳相撞，这一刻，秦华脸上的冷笑戛然而止，一股磅礴的拳力汹涌而来，咔嚓一声，秦华的右臂当场骨折，身体蹭蹭蹭的后退，脸上冷汗如雨，满脸痛苦之色。
另一边。
秦仲也不好过，被秦浩的一脚扫中，犹如被巨钟重重撞击在胸口，肋骨都断裂几根，满脸痛苦之色，躺在地上不断哀嚎。
“秦浩，你、你……”
秦华看了看躺在地上哀嚎的秦仲，又看了看秦浩，脸色苍白，满是恐惧、惊骇之色，“不可能，秦浩，你……你一个废物，就算虎啸拳大成，你也只是淬体境一重，怎么会同时击败我和秦仲！”
秦华完全无法接受这个结果。
content_en:
"Qin Zhong, Qin Hua?"
Qin Hao frowned, "What do you want from me?"
These two people are direct descendants of the Qin family.
Before the martial arts test, these two people were Qin Hao's followers. They often followed Qin Hao and respected him very much.
But now there is no respect, his face is full of contempt and disdain.
Qin Zhong's tone was sour and he said jealously: "Of course I am asking you for the Body Tempering Pills. Don't think we don't know. The master of the house gave you twenty Body Tempering Pills. Qin Hao, you are a waste. It is a waste to hold so many Body Tempering Pills. Why not give them to us!"
Qin Hua said bitterly: "That's right, Qin Hao, don't be disrespectful. Although the two of us are average in cultivation, we are already at the second level of the Body Tempering Realm, which is more than enough to deal with you, a waste!
If you don’t want to be beaten, then hand over the Body Tempering Pill honestly! "
Qin Hao was startled. Not long after he got the Body Tempering Pill, these two people came to his door. It seemed that this incident caused quite a stir in the family.
Qin Hao glanced at the two of them coldly and said, "I have taken the Body Tempering Pill, you guys go away!"
Qin Hua's face suddenly turned cold and he sneered, "Qin Hao, look for a legitimate reason. Even Master Qin Fang can't refine twenty Body Tempering Pills in half a day, let alone you, a loser. It seems that you won't shed tears until you see the coffin. Since you are looking for a fight, I will help you!"
"Thunderbolt punch!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Qin Hua laughed ferociously, waved his right fist and punched Qin Hao fiercely.
"Seeking death!"
Qin Hao was furious. Even if he didn't cause trouble for the two of them, they still dared to attack him. The anger in his heart exploded. He shouted violently and punched them as well.
Yellow level primary martial skill, Tiger Roaring Fist!
Like a tiger roaring, biting down, menacingly.
"No, it's Dacheng's Tiger Roaring Fist. Qin Hua, let me help you!"
Qin Zhong, who was standing nearby, was shocked. He jumped forward and punched Qin Hao as well.
"Hmph!"
Qin Hao was not afraid at all. When he punched Qin Hua, he swept his right foot towards Qin Zhong. Suddenly, the wind was like a shadow, and Qin Zhong only felt the roar of the wind.
Bang bang!
One punch!
One kick!
It hit Qin Hua and Qin Zhong almost at the same time.
"Ah!
my hand!
Qin Hao, how dare you destroy my arm! "
The fists collided. At this moment, the sneer on Qin Hua's face stopped abruptly. A majestic punch force surged forward. With a click, Qin Hua's right arm was fractured on the spot. His body retreated slowly, with cold sweat pouring down his face and a look of pain on his face.
other side.
Qin Zhong was not having a good time either. Being hit by Qin Hao's kick was like being hit hard on the chest by a giant bell. Several of his ribs were broken. His face was full of pain and he lay on the ground wailing.
"Qin Hao, you, you..."
Qin Hua looked at Qin Zhong, who was lying on the ground wailing, and then at Qin Hao. His face was pale, full of fear and horror, "Impossible, Qin Hao, you... you are a loser. Even if you have mastered the Tiger Roaring Fist, you are only at the first level of the Body Tempering Realm. How could you defeat Qin Zhong and me at the same time!"
Qin Hua couldn't accept this result at all.
